newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen steady to lower ahead of data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen steady to lower ahead of data.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are unlikely to snap their recent string of losses on Thursday, as investors adopt an even more cautious stance ahead of jobless claims and producer price reports.

"This market is temporarily on the defensive and we're getting some important producer price index numbers tomorrow," said Hildegard Zagorski, market analyst at Prudential Securities. "I don't think anyone's going to send the market higher this morning."
